items.title: 第八届智源大会即将在6月12日-13日正式开启
items.raw_excerpt: 这一年，人工智能发展的底层逻辑正在发生改变。 热度并未退潮，而在加速前进。更重要的变化是，人工智能正在从“能力竞赛”走向“系统落地” —— 如何在真实世界中稳定运行、持续演化，并真正嵌入人类社会与产业体系。 以 智能体（Agent） 为代表的新一代系统范式正在兴起。AI不再只是生成内容的工具，而是逐步嵌入工作流，具备持续感知、决策与执行能力。从“回答问题”到“完成任务”，从单轮交互到长时序闭环，人工智能正在走向参与行动与决策的系统形态。 同时，面向物理世界的 世界模型（World model） 正加速孕育。从多模态理解到空间与动态建模，AI开始以“状态”为核心刻画现实世界的演化规律与因果机制，从“生成符号”走向“与物理世界互动”。 智能体需要更强的世界建模能力，才能在复杂环境中稳定执行；而世界模型也需要通过行动与反馈，形成闭环学习与持续优化。由此，AI发展进入一个新的阶段—— 能够在真实世界中运行的“智能系统” 。 但在能力跃迁的同时，一系列关键问题也日益凸显，包括下一代AI技术路径与未来系统形态如何构建、对齐与治理如何前置而非事后修补、智能商业闭环如何打通等等。 第八届北京智源大会将于2026年6月12日-13日在北京中关村国际创新中心重磅开启。 延续七载硬核学术基因，汇聚图灵奖得主、海内外顶尖学者与产业领袖，智源大会将在思辨与实证中，让智能真正落地生根，为下一代人工智能的发展建立更清晰的坐标系。 全球AI领袖齐聚，共绘进化蓝图 自2019年启幕，北京智源大会已经连续成功举办七届，凭借国际视野和专业深度，成为全球AI从业者不可错过的年度盛事。七年来，12位图灵奖得主、近千位顶尖专家亲临现场，吸引全球30多个国家和地区、累计超60万人次专业人士参与，成为全球AI创新的重要风向标。 2026年6月12日至13日，第八届智源大会将以“线上+线下”联动的形式于北京中关村国际创新中

excerpt_i18n.zh: 这一年，人工智能发展的底层逻辑正在发生改变。 热度并未退潮，而在加速前进。更重要的变化是，人工智能正在从“能力竞赛”走向“系统落地” —— 如何在真实世界中稳定运行、持续演化，并真正嵌入人类社会与产业体系。 以 智能体（Agent） 为代表的新一代系统范式正在兴起。AI不再只是生成内容的工具，而是逐步嵌入工作流，具备持续感知、决策与执行能力。从“回答问题”到“完成任务”，从单轮交互到长时序闭环，人工智能正在走向参与行动与决策的系统形态。 同时，面向物理世界的 世界模型（World model） 正加速孕育。从多模态理解到空间与动态建模，AI开始以“状态”为核心刻画现实世界的演化规律与因果机制，从“生成符号”走向“与物理世界互动”。 智能体需要更强的世界建模能力，才能在复杂环境中稳定执行；而世界模型也需要通过行动与反馈，形成闭环学习与持续优化。由此，AI发展进入一个新的阶段—— 能够在真实世界中运行的“智能系统” 。 但在能力跃迁的同时，一系列关键问题也日益凸显，包括下一代AI技术路径与未来系统形态如何构建、对齐与治理如何前置而非事后修补、智能商业闭环如何打通等等。 第八届北京智源大会将于2026年6月12日-13日在北京中关村国际创新中心重磅开启。 延续七载硬核学术基因，汇聚图灵奖得主、海内外顶尖学者与产业领袖，智源大会将在思辨与实证中，让智能真正落地生根，为下一代人工智能的发展建立更清晰的坐标系。 全球AI领袖齐聚，共绘进化蓝图 自2019年启幕，北京智源大会已经连续成功举办七届，凭借国际视野和专业深度，成为全球AI从业者不可错过的年度盛事。七年来，12位图灵奖得主、近千位顶尖专家亲临现场，吸引全球30多个国家和地区、累计超60万人次专业人士参与，成为全球AI创新的重要风向标。 2026年6月12日至13日，第八届智源大会将以“线上+线下”联动的形式于北京中关村国际创新中
excerpt_i18n.en: The underlying logic of AI development is shifting this year. The momentum has not waned but is accelerating. More importantly, AI is transitioning from a "capability competition" to "system deployment"—how to operate stably, evolve continuously, and truly embed into human society and industrial systems in the real world. A new generation of system paradigms, represented by agents, is emerging. AI is no longer just a tool for generating content but is gradually integrating into workflows, with capabilities for continuous perception, decision-making, and execution. From "answering questions" to "completing tasks," from single-turn interactions to long-sequence closed loops, AI is evolving into a system form that participates in actions and decisions. Meanwhile, world models oriented toward the physical world are accelerating development. From multimodal understanding to spatial and dynamic modeling, AI is beginning to depict the evolution laws and causal mechanisms of the real world with "states" as the core, moving from "generating symbols" to "interacting with the physical world." Agents require stronger world modeling capabilities to execute stably in complex environments, while world models need actions and feedback to form closed-loop learning and continuous optimization. Thus, AI development enters a new phase—"intelligent systems" capable of operating in the real world. However, alongside capability leaps, a series of critical issues are becoming increasingly prominent, including how to construct next-generation AI technology pathways and future system forms, how to embed alignment and governance upfront rather than as post-hoc fixes, and how to achieve intelligent business closed loops. The 8th Beijing Zhiyuan Conference will address these topics.
excerpt_i18n.es: Este año, la lógica subyacente del desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial está cambiando. El entusiasmo no se ha desvanecido, sino que se acelera. Un cambio más importante es que la IA está pasando de una "competencia de capacidades" a una "implementación sistémica": cómo operar de manera estable en el mundo real, evolucionar continuamente e integrarse realmente en la sociedad humana y los sistemas industriales. Está surgiendo un nuevo paradigma sistémico representado por los agentes inteligentes. La IA ya no es solo una herramienta para generar contenido, sino que se integra gradualmente en los flujos de trabajo, con capacidades de percepción continua, toma de decisiones y ejecución. Desde "responder preguntas" hasta "completar tareas", desde interacciones únicas hasta bucles cerrados de larga duración, la inteligencia artificial avanza hacia una forma sistémica que participa en acciones y decisiones.

items.title: 做一辆不卖的车，小米究竟在想什么？
items.raw_excerpt: 2026年4月的北京车展，小米汽车展台中央停着一辆不会开上公路的车——Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo。这是小米首款概念超跑，也是Vision Gran Turismo项目诞生以来第51台概念车，更是第一台出自中国品牌之手、第一台由科技公司打造的作品。 此前，布加迪、法拉利、保时捷、兰博基尼们是这个殿堂的常客。小米作为第36个受邀品牌，带来的不只是又一辆虚拟世界里的数字跑车，而是一份关于"科技公司如何参与汽车工业顶层设计"的答卷。换句话说，当山内一典向小米发出邀约的那一刻，小米汽车在中国汽车工业设计的话语权就已经出现了变化。 VGT殿堂的入场券 Vision Gran Turismo项目由索尼《Gran Turismo》系列制作人山内一典发起，邀请全球顶尖汽车制造商抛开现实约束，为GT模拟驾驶平台打造未来超跑概念车。自项目启动以来，仅有36个国际一流汽车品牌获得受邀资格，此前出品过Vision GT概念车的名单读起来像一份超跑名人录：布加迪Vision GT、法拉利Vision GT、兰博基尼V12 Vision GT、保时捷Vision GT、梅赛德斯-AMG Vision GT…… 小米的加入，打破了两个纪录：首个中国品牌，以及首个科技公司。 含金量之高，从参与门槛即可窥见。有行业人士告诉雷峰网："Vision GT不是品牌想参加就能参加的，山内一典本人对每一家受邀品牌都有深入考量。这个项目本质上是汽车设计界的最高殿堂，它认可的不只是你现有产品的销量，而是你在工程设计、美学表达和未来出行理念上的综合实力。" 对小米而言，这份邀约的分量远超一辆概念车本身。从2021年宣布造车到2026年北京车展，小米汽车用五年时间完成了从行业质疑到销量登顶的跨越：SU7与YU7累计交付突破66万辆，SU7 Ultra原型车以6分

excerpt_i18n.es: En el Salón del Automóvil de Pekín de abril de 2026, en el centro del stand de Xiaomi Automóviles se exhibe un vehículo que nunca circulará por carretera: el Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo. Se trata del primer superdeportivo conceptual de Xiaomi, el 51.º vehículo conceptual desde el nacimiento del proyecto Vision Gran Turismo, y el primero creado por una marca china y desarrollado por una empresa tecnológica. excerpt_i18n.en: AI Tech Review exclusively learned that general-purpose embodied intelligent robot company Infinite Dynamics has recently completed its Angel++ round of financing, with total Angel round funding exceeding $200 million. (The author has long tracked the embodied intelligence & robotics sector; feel free to add WeChat for communication: zhangxian2021) It is understood that Infinite Dynamics' Angel++ round was co-invested by Envision Group and the Beijing Artificial Intelligence Industry Investment Fund, with follow-on investments from multiple existing shareholders including Sequoia China, Linear Capital, Hillhouse Ventures, BV Baidu Ventures, Huaye Tiancheng, and Junsan Capital. Additionally, sources revealed that Infinite Dynamics' Angel+++ round is also nearing completion, having secured support from internet industry capital and top-tier dollar and RMB funds. Information from relevant investors indicates that Infinite Dynamics' technical route selection was key to the rapid completion of this financing round. It is understood that Infinite Dynamics has chosen to build a general-purpose embodied brain, MWA™, centered on a latent space world model, deliberately distinguishing itself from the mainstream VLA architecture. The logic is that the VLA paradigm suffers from information loss in cross-representation mapping between language and action, whereas a world model based on latent space can complete perception, training, and reasoning within a unified representation space, reducing feature fragmentation. Under this technical framework, reinforcement learning plays the role of continuously iterating decision-making strategies, forming a closed-loop synergy with the world model. The deep coupling, closed-loop collaboration, and efficient autonomous operation of these two components help the embodied intelligence brain achieve capability leaps and exponential iterative evolution in intelligence levels.

items.title: What type of code should you generate with AI?
items.raw_excerpt:
I (and many people) have been thinking a lot about "what are the best tasks to do using AI."
My personal framework I've been using is, you should use AI to generate code when: 1. The code is easy to validate 2. It is not important that a human understands it I find that the best thing to AI generate is something on the level of a pure function (easy to validate + not necessarily important to understand implementation as long as you understand the interface). I've tried doing things like generating whole services or applications, but those often violate rule 1 - it's hard to validate an entire application behaves "correctly" when "correctly" isn't really well defined - i.e., are there memory leaks, is it secure, is it able to be monitored, etc. I'm curious of others thoughts on this topic.

It is not important that a human understands it I find that the best thing to AI generate is something on the level of a pure function (easy to validate + not necessarily important to understand implementation as long as you understand the interface).
